searches.reason: Investigate the mismatch between random masked-item reconstruction and appended-mask next-item inference. Compare prefix-based terminal masking with mixed terminal/interior masking inside one BERT4Rec model. Preserve bidirectional attention without exposing targets; assess gains using fixed macro validation HR@10.

searches.reason: Investigate stronger candidate discrimination, especially for Industrial_and_Scientific and Electronics, where measured lower-tail margins are negative. Seek practical sampled-softmax or hard-negative objectives with false-negative safeguards; the diagnostics do not establish embedding collapse or validation performance.
searches.query: BERT4Rec sequential recommendation 2023 2024 2025 2026 sampled softmax adaptive hard negative sampling false negatives masked item prediction

searches.reason: Explore jointly learned item-text and temporal features within one BERT4Rec network to distinguish specific compatibility and recent intent from broad similarity. Use only supplied titles, descriptions, timestamps and histories, with text representations trained from scratch; treat compatibility as a hypothesis requiring validation.
searches.query: BERT4Rec 2023 2024 2025 2026 time aware attention item title description jointly trained text embeddings sequential recommendation without pretrained models
